description: Renewable deployment can scale quickly but depends on grids storage land governance and supply chains.
Grid modernization enables clean power integration electrification flexibility and resilience.
Storage and flexible demand support reliability in high-renewable systems.
Building electrification can reduce emissions and health harms if affordability and workforce capacity are addressed.
Transport electrification depends on charging networks public transit battery systems and equitable access.
Managed phase-down requires worker protection regional investment methane control and cleanup.
Heavy industry requires electrification hydrogen carbon management circularity and public industrial strategy.
Mineral governance recycling substitution and material efficiency shape the justice of clean technology scale-up.
